role: Social intranet scalar posts, comments, content state and file metadata
known_patches: Integer schemas for existing identity arguments
User id 1 persona and consistent personal containers; synthetic secondary users retained
Concrete target/owner/substring read filters; remove ineffective default list truncation; no write executor changed
limitations: create_post creates only Post and does not create its Content wrapper, channel association or published stream entry. No full post_channel or send_dm capability is claimed.
No direct-message, Space creation or membership write interfaces exist. Helpers seed existing world rows only.
move_content uses crud.delete and removes Content instead of moving it; schedule_content sets a date without scheduled-state transition.
mark_notifications_seen updates only one matching notification; content lock flags are not enforced by create_comment.
upload_file/download_file store/read scalar file metadata, not binary bytes; supplied object attachments and hideInStream are not implemented.

search_content filters published metadata, not post message full text; date and pageSize source args are unsupported. Raw general read/write ACLs are incomplete; original authored-comment and file-uploader guards are retained.
Author/container GUID filters require known GUIDs; unresolved optional references act as omitted filters and may broaden the returned metadata set.
